description: what the bundled interface is allowed to do. The window now loads a static export of apps/web from inside the bundle, so this capability is local: it carries no `remote.urls` block and no remote origin inherits it. Window control is enumerated command by command because the frameless window has no system frame to fall back on — every entry below is called by apps/web/components/screenkit/desktop. Also here: opening links in the system browser, the folder picker and the app data directory; the local files themselves are read through the local_* commands, and the granted root is added to the asset protocol scope at runtime (there is no static $ROOT to write here).
